lines: ARVIND KONDANGI LAKSHMIKUMAR, a Promoter, is set to receive money from selling 1,150,000 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of up to ₹80.50 crore are scheduled on or about Friday, October 23, 2026, 23 days ago, per the offer timetable.
Retained shares are valued at an estimated ₹267.29 crore at offer price, so more value may follow after listing.
Gain is unknown: average cost of acquisition is not confirmed from the documents.
